infoLinks.urlText: L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line weekend full closure due to maintenance
infoLinks.content:
On Saturday 10 and Sunday 11 January, L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line light rail services will not run due to planned trackwork and maintenance works.
 
During this time, use alternative transport including L4 replacement bus services, trains, regular bus services or walking if able to between Westmead and Carlingford.
 
L4 replacement bus services:
 
Replacement bus services will run every 10 to 15 minutes from 5am to 1am daily. These times may vary depending on road traffic.
Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:
  • Westmead Hospital - Please use the alternative stop at Westmead Station (approx. 6 minute walk)
  • Ngara - Please use the alternative stop at Benaud Oval (approx. 5 minute walk)
  • Rosehill Gardens – Please use the alternative stop at Tramway Avenue (approx. 10 minute walk)
Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service.
 
See the news story for more detailed service information.
 
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.

  • Buses replace trains between Cabramatta and Granville.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern between Leppington and Lidcombe via Regents Park, and between Schofields and Olympic Park.
